Name: Yuriyuri MOD (portraits only)
Author: snowcmpie
Description:
HOW TO USE:

For people who use SMAPI, download the file with content patcher, and extract it to your mod folder.

For people who don't use SMAPI: download the file without content patcher. Extract it and throw the xnb files to your Stardew Valley -> Content -> Portraits folder. Don't forget to back up!
